baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from maskan through the two gardens, eating, provision, gratitude, good town, and Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inhabited place is flanked by food-bearing gardens; eating converts apportioned sustenance into life, while gratitude returns recognition to the cultivating Lord. The good town is the communal condition in which source, use, and response remain coupled.

activation_trace.role: Inhabiting a home fixes the provisioning circuit at the scale of settled communal life.
Taking food is the circuit's use and incorporation node, not merely a view of abundance.
Apportioned giving identifies the food as received provision rather than autonomous possession.
Cultivation, repair, and completion supply the sustaining agency behind both provision and town.
Recognition and manifestation of benefit close the human response side of the circuit.
The bounded land turns the mechanism from private feeding into a civic ecology.
Good, wholesome quality names the integrated condition of the inhabited land.

changed_reading.before: A fertile town offers food and asks its residents to give thanks.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a settled provisioning circuit: cultivated gift becomes nourishment, responsive gratitude, and a wholesome communal habitat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Jannatan at the right and left, followed by a forgiving Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: The settlement is materially enclosed by two garden-covers: the right activates blessing and potency, while the left activates all-around inclusion. This botanical protection is echoed by forgiveness as a covering that shields a person from the effect of fault.

activation_trace.role: The garden's root-image of a protective cover makes the paired gardens a sheltering boundary.
The right flank contributes blessing and fortunate potency to one side of the enclosure.
The left flank contributes encompassing inclusion, completing protection from the other side.
Forgiveness adds a moral cover that protects the inhabitant from a fault's destructive effect.

changed_reading.before: The two gardens mark a favorable location on both sides of the settlement.
changed_reading.after: The dwelling is nested inside complementary material and moral covers: bilateral garden protection and a Lord's protective forgiveness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kulu from the Lord's rizq and give shukr to Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch inventory lets gratitude be read as a yield-response: little input becomes visibly effective, fresh growth appears, and nourishment matures. Coupled to eating and cultivating lordship, shukr is not only speech but the manifestation of received provision as renewed life.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency from little input and its visible effect make gratitude a multiplier-like response.
Fresh shoots give that response a concrete image of renewed outward growth.
Crop yield links the command to eat with the productive output of the gardens.
Provision as descending rain supplies an ecological input behind the edible yield.
The non-dominant mapped branch of feeding and growth supplies the maturation process.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is an acknowledgement spoken after consuming provision.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is also the visible, efficient conversion of received provision into renewed growth and flourishing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: There was in their maskan an ayah: the two gardens and the ensuing imperative-description sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sign is located inside ordinary habitation and consists of an arranged relation among dwelling, flanking gardens, use, response, land, and Lord. The ayah is therefore an inhabitable configuration, not an isolated marvel detached from daily life.

activation_trace.role: A visible marker makes the whole following arrangement evidentiary.
A place of settled stability locates the evidence within lived habitat.
The tree-covered gardens provide the sign's inspectable material structure.
The bounded town makes the sign a spatial and communal arrangement.

changed_reading.before: A remarkable pair of gardens serves as a sign for Saba.
changed_reading.after: The sign is the lived arrangement itself: a dwelling-scale interface joining ecology, consumption, gratitude, civic quality, and lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding work scene explicitly couples intentional making with shukr and contrasts it with the small number of truly grateful servants. This strengthens the focus imperative into practiced stewardship: gratitude is enacted by maintaining and rightly using the conditions that feed the town.

activation_trace.role: The focus command supplies gratitude as recognition and manifestation of received benefit.
Intentional action turns gratitude from a verbal response into a mode of concrete making.
The explicit work-shukr coupling names recognition of benefit as the work's governing response.
Small number and scarcity mark enacted gratitude as a demanding, uncommon achievement.

structural_cues: 34:13 places an imperative to work directly beside shukr and then says the shakur are few.
34:15 repeats the shukr imperative after permission to eat, moving the work-response pattern into a town's food system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit work-shukr coupling and the later eat-shukr coupling; I infer that maintaining and using the habitat well is gratitude's civic form. A live alternative is that 34:13 names gratitude as the purpose or state of work without specifying ecological maintenance.

changed_reading.before: Residents should acknowledge the giver after enjoying the gardens.
changed_reading.after: Residents are summoned to perform gratitude through the skilled use, upkeep, and responsive continuation of the provisioning habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning one's side away is followed by the substitution of two gardens for two gardens: the spatial shell remains named alike while edible quality collapses. The covering-of-benefit branch of kufr makes the reversal exact: concealing gift changes a wholesome provisioning sign into a low-yield counter-sign.

activation_trace.role: Wholesome goodness identifies the initial habitat's integrated quality.
Protective forgiveness keeps moral recoverability present before the narrated reversal.
Turning the side away supplies the relational break that opens the reversal sequence.
One thing standing in another's place preserves the two-garden form while replacing its quality.
The repeated garden image makes the replacement a changed ecology rather than simple absence.
Crop yield becomes the diagnostic variable by which the replacement gardens differ.
Covering a benefit names the failed response that functionally inverts grateful manifestation.

structural_cues: 34:16 repeats the dual-garden construction but changes its produce after an explicit turning away.
34:17 interprets the replacement as recompense for kufr, creating a direct shukr-kufr response contrast with 34:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a turn, flood, substitution, degraded produce, and recompense; I infer that civic goodness is relationally maintained and therefore reversible. The replacement could also be read primarily as imposed judgment rather than ecological feedback, so the mechanism should not erase divine agency.

changed_reading.before: Good town describes a stable possession whose abundance demonstrates favor.
changed_reading.after: Good town names a recoverable but non-automatic habitat condition: the same garden form can remain while its nourishing quality is reversed when gift is covered rather than manifested.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, visible signhood attaches not only to flourishing but also to threatened surroundings and the memory of fragmentation. Return, patient restraint, and gratitude are reader-dispositions that let the same habitat remain legible before, during, and after loss.

activation_trace.role: The focus marks the thriving dwelling arrangement as visible evidence.
A visible marker in the surrounding threat expands signhood beyond pleasant abundance.
Habitual return supplies the receptive posture by which a surrounding configuration becomes a sign.
Tearing into dispersed pieces turns destroyed social geography into retrospective evidence.
The plural visible markers explicitly classify the aftermath as sign-bearing.
Holding oneself from panic enables sustained reading when the sign appears through loss.
Recognition of benefit enables comparison between flourishing gift and its covered aftermath.

structural_cues: 34:9 calls the full before-behind and sky-earth surround a sign for one who returns.
34:15 locates a sign in a thriving dwelling.
34:19 calls the community's fragmentation signs for every patient and grateful reader.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three sign scenes and their reader postures; I infer that signhood lies in a reversible relation and its history, not only in a positive object. A live alternative is that each scene is an independent proof with no intended temporal model.

changed_reading.before: The flourishing gardens themselves are the sign.
changed_reading.after: The sign is the habitat's legible history: flourishing, vulnerability, reversal, and remembered fragmentation all disclose the relation between gift and response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good dwelling expands into a measured, secure route network; the request to manufacture distance is followed by social tearing. The surah's close then reverses their wish: the Lord is near, seizure comes from a near place, attempted appropriation from a distant place cannot reach, and a barrier finally interposes. Nearness is thus part of the habitat's mercy and timely accessibility.

activation_trace.role: A place of settled stability anchors the focus in accessible habitation rather than isolated abundance.
Deliberate apportioning of travel supplies a designed rhythm of reachable stages.
Settled confidence makes route accessibility a form of lived security.
Actively producing distance is the requested deformation of the near route network.
Tearing into pieces realizes manufactured distance as communal and geographic fragmentation.
Divine nearness preserves the positive pole of accessible relation at the surah's close.
Reaching by extension names the now-failed attempt to take hold of belief or rescue.
Distance explains why the attempted reach is no longer timely or effective.
A separating barrier is the terminal form of the accessibility they earlier asked to undo.

structural_cues: 34:18 presents visible settlements, measured travel, and safety by night and day.
34:19 immediately links requested distance with self-wronging and dispersion.
34:50-54 repeatedly oppose nearness, distance, failed reach, and final interposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designed travel, requested distancing, dispersion, near/far reach language, and a final barrier; I infer a single accessibility mechanism joining them. The close may primarily concern temporal nearness to judgment rather than civic geography, so the spatial echo remains analogical rather than identity.

changed_reading.before: A good town is a fertile and secure local residence.
changed_reading.after: A good town is also an architecture of timely nearness: provision, neighboring stages, safety, response, and forgiveness remain within reach before chosen distance hardens into separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision descends through the sky-earth order, is expanded or constricted, exits possession as expenditure, and is followed by replacement. Eating in the focus is one legitimate throughput within this larger circulation; the good town receives, uses, and releases provision rather than treating abundance as a self-securing stock.

activation_trace.role: Apportioned gift identifies the garden food as one moment in a larger provisioning flow.
Eating is the embodied use-stage through which provision sustains recipients.
Provision sourced through heavens and earth places the town inside a wider vertical economy of gift.
Expansion, increase, and surplus supply the widening phase of provision.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the narrowing phase without changing the giver.
The exit of wealth in expenditure turns possession outward into circulation.
Something coming after and taking the spent thing's place keeps release from being the circuit's endpoint.
Repeated provisioning language identifies expansion, spending, and replacement as one governed flow.

structural_cues: 34:24 locates provisioning in the sky-earth relation.
34:36 and 34:39 repeat expansion and constriction of rizq.
34:39 adds expenditure, replacement, and the superlative provider, while 34:35-37 deny that accumulated wealth itself guarantees safety or nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies source, expansion, constriction, expenditure, and replacement; I infer a circulation norm that revises static ownership. Replacement may be non-material or deferred, so this is not a promise of immediate commercial return.

changed_reading.before: Eat from the stored abundance that belongs to your town.
changed_reading.after: Receive and use one share of a moving provision whose source exceeds the town and whose healthy social form includes release rather than hoarding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a material dual garden to a later discipline of thinking in pairs through branch recurrence, not through explicit syntax. It remains validly anchored in jannatan and ayah, with 34:46 supplying pairing, reflection, and a contrasting JNN branch. Downstream prose should present it as an epistemic analogy, not claim that the gardens lexically mean a reasoning method.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dual form jannatan as the visible ayah between right and left.

activation_trace.role: Two tree-covered gardens provide the paired material objects available for comparative attention.
Their arrangement is explicitly marked as visible evidence to be read.
Joining one to one as two activates pairing as an epistemic posture rather than mere quantity.
The heart's repeated turning supplies the comparative act performed on the pair.
The denied covering of reason creates a sharp cross-branch contrast with the garden-cover that invites reflection.

changed_reading.before: The number two reports how many gardens Saba possessed.
changed_reading.after: The paired gardens can also function as a built prompt to compare two flanks and think through balance, enclosure, and response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the same eating root moves across nourishment, silent corrosion, and degraded crop yield. It remains anchored in the focus imperative kulu and in exact whole-surah occurrences immediately around it. Downstream prose should distinguish these modes and must not imply that the commanded eating in 34:15 is itself destructive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative kulu from the Lord's provision.

activation_trace.role: Taking nourishment is the focus's constructive mode of consumption.
Corrosion and decay turn eating into a silent process that removes a support and exposes hidden fragility.
The hidden agents become exposed when corrosive consumption brings the supporting structure down.
Crop yield becomes degraded output, showing that not every available consumption loop is wholesome.

changed_reading.before: Eating simply confirms that the gardens are beneficial.
changed_reading.after: Eating is diagnostic: it can nourish a grateful circuit, silently consume its supports, or register the bitter output of a reversed ecology.

strongest_changes: Gratitude became intentional work that maintains and rightly uses a provisioning habitat.
The good town became a reversible quality: identical garden form can persist while nourishing function collapses.
The sign expanded from prosperous object to a history legible through warning, flourishing, fragmentation, patience, and gratitude.
Measured nearness and circulation emerged as civic dimensions of goodness, while chosen distance, hoarding, and failed reach mark breakdown.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet turned a compact garden tableau into a worked, reversible, connected, and circulating habitat. The most distinctive activations were the near-far closure in 34:18-19 and 34:50-54, and the three sharply different modes of eating across 34:14-16.
remaining_uncertainties: The yield-like branches of shukr support an ecological feedback reading, but they do not by themselves prove a causal agricultural claim.
The closing near-far sequence may be primarily temporal and eschatological; its civic-spatial resonance with Saba remains analogical.
The paired-reflection outlier is intentionally exploratory and should not be rendered as lexical equivalence.
